title: Create a Meta Ads carousel creative
phrases: make an ad with several swipeable cards
prepare a multi-slide social media ad
create a carousel from these product images
upload two to ten linked ad cards

safety.rule: Requires META_ADS_WRITES_ENABLED=true for a live run. Dry run is the default; pass dryRun:false to create. Creates a creative only, never an ad. Runs the Meta policy check first; a BLOCK is refused unless policyOverride holds a reason, which is audited.
